verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party LM Studio SDK. It does document a REST API for your own apps and scripts, plus OpenAI-like endpoints, and community users confirm the OpenAI-compatible server works. So developers can build against it with third-party OpenAI client libraries or raw HTTP, but not an official SDK. Missing for 10: any evidence of official LM Studio SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript client libraries), SDK documentation, and hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
